problem: HIVE Core events do not carry an observed correlation_id, so movement pulses and task/agent records cannot be linked to the interaction that caused them; registry records carry correlation_id=null.
expected_benefit: Event-linked pulses, task records and audit entries could be joined on a real id instead of time proximity.
test_plan: contract test: events with and without correlation_id
no pulse or link is drawn when correlation_id is absent
registry records keep correlation_id=null when the source omits it
rollback_plan: Revert the commit; the current behaviour (no correlation, no inferred link) is the safe fallback.

problem: No approval source connector exists; Approve/Reject are local only and Edit is disabled, so no approval can be confirmed by its source.
expected_benefit: Source-confirmed approvals with expiry, replay protection and an audit record, shown separately from local decisions.
test_plan: a local decision stays labelled local until the source confirms it
replayed or expired approvals are rejected
unavailable source keeps the approval UNKNOWN
rollback_plan: Revert the connector; local-only labelling remains the fail-closed default.

problem: Redaction is a best-effort regex with documented limits (short opaque secrets can pass), and the registry reuses it for catalog metadata.
expected_benefit: Fewer secret-shaped strings reaching the browser from event summaries and catalog descriptions.
test_plan: assert no catalog description or event summary in fixtures contains a corpus secret
rollback_plan: Revert the pattern change; the current regex stays in place.
